📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter the first term a₁ and common ratio r.
  2. Enter the term number n.
  3. Press Calculate for the nth term, partial sum and infinite sum.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is a geometric sequence?
Each term multiplies by the same ratio r: a₁, a₁·r, a₁·r², …
When does the infinite sum exist?
Only when |r| < 1 — then the terms shrink to zero and S∞ = a₁/(1−r).
What if r = 1?
Every term equals a₁, so the nth term is a₁ and the sum of n terms is n·a₁.
